postNode.description: A resolved post in a Thread Lens response. Hydrated anonymously: viewer state is always empty.

gapNode.description: A post that could not be shown, with a typed reason. Every per-URI failure is expressed as a gap rather than an error.

gap.description: Why the post is not shown. 'blocked' reflects a block between other parties, never the viewer; 'tier-hidden' is emitted for every private-tier URI regardless of existence or viewer.
